0.2.2:
## What's new
- Fixed: servers in Japan (and elsewhere) were shown as United States on the game card and in Settings → Server; they are now placed where they really are
- Fixed: clicking a play link a second time while Roblox was still starting could show a false error
- Fixed: "Reinstall Roblox" could run while a launch was in progress; it now waits
- Smoother option selectors: they no longer redraw needlessly
- Removed unused leftovers from earlier versions, so the app is a little smaller
- Settings → Server: the recent games list scrolls (and keeps up to 500), and the history can be deleted by age: older than 1 hour / 1 day / 1 week / 1 month, or all of it
- Fixed: after restarting Luna, Settings → Server said "No game joined yet" next to a list of recent games; it now shows the last server
0.2.1:
## What's new
- Game card: now also shows ping and the player count, and fades out properly
- New Settings → Server: the current (or last) server with ping and players, a list of recent games, and a button that copies a link to join the same server
- Saved skyboxes: the preview is the front (ft) face, or any face you have if some are missing
- Renaming a saved skybox, renaming a mod profile and editing a FastFlag now end when you click anywhere else
- ReCache / Clear cache: the "Roblox is running" check is stricter and names the process it found
- Updates: shows the installed Roblox version, with a "Reinstall Roblox" button
- Animations when "Delete?" goes back to normal, when a rename ends, and when "Check for updates" switches to its checking state
0.2.0:
## What's new
- Luna now installs and updates Roblox itself, so Roblox's own installer window is gone: progress shows in Luna's window (with Cancel), and play links open it too
- While you play, Luna's window hides and comes back when Roblox closes (Settings → Advanced → Hide Luna while playing)
- A card at the bottom right when you join a game: its name and where the server is, with the same low-poly moon as the home screen (Settings → Advanced → Game card)
- Preset options (FPS limit, …): thinner, fainter dividers, rounded options, and the selected one now slides to the one you pick
- This window now fades out when you close it
- More motion: settings and their rows arrive one after another, lists and messages fade in, the skybox templates unfold, choices send out a soft ring, buttons squeeze when pressed
0.1.3:
## What's new
- The version shown in Luna (and in the installer's file name) now always matches the release
- Patch notes are built into the app: shown once after an update, and any time from Settings → Updates → Patch notes
- Preset options (FPS limit, Graphics API, …) are now one framed control with dividers
- The version is shown at the bottom of the home screen
0.1.2:
## What's new
- Light theme is now the dark scene with its lights and darks swapped (pale sky, dark moon), window tab included
- 8 colour palettes (Settings → Advanced → Palette), each with a dark and a light form
- Skybox: "My skyboxes" — save your own set under a name, rename it, apply it any time
- Skybox reset also turns off hand-made skybox profiles, so the faces no longer light up again
- Skybox fix is automatic: applied with any skybox, removed when you reset it
- FastFlags: "Reset all flags"; flag profiles have proper spacing
- ReCache: keeps a copy of Roblox's cache so clearing it doesn't mean downloading everything again
- Update notice at the top of the home screen when a new version is out
- Luna's own tooltips, a Delete? button that goes back to × when you click elsewhere, no more panel jitter on Load / preset clicks, readable secondary text in both themes
